signals.source_text: But more than mathematical expansion, he was experiencing mystical dissolution that transcended every framework he had developed for understanding the relationship between individual awareness and universal consciousness.
The mystical intuition Torrhen had taught him was flowing outward through dimensional barriers, merging with forces so vast that individual identity became meaningless within their scope.

Individual consciousness had become universal consciousness that maintained individual distinctiveness through universal service.

The Sage existed—not as individual teacher offering instruction in synthesis techniques, but as consciousness that existed as synthesis itself, as wisdom that demonstrated integration rather than requiring integration through individual effort, as awareness that served consciousness evolution by becoming evolution's own recognition of unlimited possibility.
